purpose: Baseline local RPCS3 setup and define a reproducible user-driven game run for collecting evidence toward the native Windows port.

scope.notes: Inspection only. RPCS3 was open at its welcome screen; no game process was running.

observed_sequence: EA/FIFA Street splash for approximately 2-3 seconds
Title screen with PRESS START BUTTON for the remainder of the sampled recording
existing_recording.analysis_limit: Frames were sampled locally; the audio track was not transcribed.

logs_at_inspection.interpretation: No useful game-run trace existed at inspection time; the emulator was idle. Recheck after the next run and normal shutdown because buffered logs may not be flushed while RPCS3 remains open.

latest_user_reported_run.user_report: User says FIFA Street launched fully and they entered a match.
latest_user_reported_run.compatibility_label_interpretation: RPCS3 compatibility-list status, not proof of this specific run reaching a match.
latest_user_reported_run.observed_current_state: RPCS3 library window; game was no longer visibly running at the time of desktop capture.
latest_user_reported_run.evidence_limit: This confirms a recent, substantial game run and records the user's report of entering a match, but there is no in-match image/video or RPCS3 log to inspect gameplay, rendering, controls, or performance.

user_run_capture_plan: Leave current RPCS3 settings and save data unchanged.
Launch the BLUS30882 entry from RPCS3.
Record the launch and the first transition away from PRESS START BUTTON.
Press Start once; wait for the next screen. If no transition appears, record the unchanged screen for 10-20 seconds and note any on-screen error.
If a menu appears, capture each transition with a short wait between inputs and record which controller input was used.
Close RPCS3 normally after the observation so logs can flush; retain the recording, screenshots, and log for analysis.
comparison_limits: RPCS3 behavior is a reference for the original game, not proof that the native port behaves the same.
A successful splash or title screen does not establish menu navigation or gameplay.
The existing recording does not show a Start press or a menu transition.
